body: I've also noticed since updating to 0.58.0 that something seems up with the character module, I'm never seeing my error_symbol
Probably related to #3049 revealing another latent bug in the ZSH init. Will investigate more when I have some spare time.

Hi, @chipbuster 

I thought you meant that I should install from source code, but it doesn't work still. Also, I tried multiple times to install with old versions such as v0.47, v0.38, v0.35, etc., just in case, but anyone didn't work. So I think I have some conflicts between my environment and starship, not a case of a bug from versioning up. Did you see the same problem in a similar environment with mine?

Hi @hyunsooda 

Sorry, my comment was meant as a note to myself to remind me where to look when I get around to debugging this thing. 

As for downgrading, did you try downgrading just one or two major versions (e.g. to 0.56)? We've had other shell init problems in older versions of starship. Also, are you restarting the shell (e.g. closing/reopening the terminal) after installation? The `starship` binary itself doesn't require a shell restart, but the init scripts (which is probably where the problem is) are only evaluated when the shell starts.

@chipbuster,

Yes, I tried a series of versions, including 0.56.0 and restarted the shell for sure after re-installation.

Strange. We'll might need some way to look at your full shell config.

For now, could you run `export STARSHIP_LOG=trace`, run a command like `false` (which should set a failed status), and then paste the results here?
